battle.name: 代州之戰
battle.brief: 雍熙三年（986）正月，宋太宗分三路北伐遼國：曹彬自雄州趨幽州，潘美與楊業自代州攻朔州。卡面的羅馬重步兵未隨軍而至，但宋軍內襯步卒以長槊、大盾結陣抵擋遼騎衝鋒，其戰力同樣建立在兵源補充與糧秣補給之上。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 交戰的兩方是北宋與契丹（遼）。北宋方面：皇帝宋太宗趙光義在雍熙三年正月下詔，以收復幽雲為目標分三路出師——東路由曹彬自雄州（今河北雄縣）率主力北上直趨幽州，中路由田重進自蒲陰方向策應，西路由潘美掛帥、楊業為行軍副將與先鋒，自代州（今山西代縣）出師，攻取朔州、應州。三路兵員以禁軍、邊軍與各州縣募兵為主，糧秣自河北、山東與河東沿線州倉調集，軍令由行軍都部署與節度使分道發出。遼方：皇帝耶律隆緒正臥病，政事由蕭太后與韓國王耶律斜軫主持；燕京統軍使統攝幽州及雁門關以北防務，兵以契丹騎兵為主，漢軍、奚軍為輔，並以遊騎屯於州縣之間，等待宋軍深入、糧道斷絕再行出擊。兩邊的指揮系統相差很遠：宋廷用文臣統軍、以驛馬傳令，遼廷則以統軍使一人節制燕雲數十州，一紙軍令即可調動精騎數萬。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Northern Song and the Khitan Liao. On the Song side, Emperor Taizong Zhao Kuangyi issued the order in the first month of the Yongxi third year (986) and split the expedition into three columns with the recovery of You and Yun as the stated purpose: Cao Bin led the eastern column out of Xiongzhou, in present-day Xiongxian, Hebei, with the main body heading straight for Youzhou; Tian Chongjin operated out of the Puyin direction as the central column; and Pan Mei held overall command of the western column, with Yang Ye as deputy and vanguard, marching out of Daizhou, in present-day Dai County, Shanxi, to seize Shuozhou and Yingzhou. Song troops came mainly from the imperial guard, the frontier garrisons and locally recruited provincial levies, while grain and pay were drawn from the provincial granaries of Hebei, Shandong and Hedong, and orders travelled through the commanders of the march and the provincial military commissioners. On the Liao side the emperor Yelü Longxu lay ill, and government and command rested with Empress Dowager Xiao and the Prince of Korea, Yelü Xiezhen; the commander at Yanjing directed the defence of Youzhou and of everything north of Yumen Pass. Liao troops were chiefly Khitan cavalry with Chinese and Xi auxiliaries, and parties of light horse patrolled between the prefectures, waiting for the Song columns to run deep and their supply lines to snap before striking. The two command systems were very far apart: the Song court used civil officials to lead armies and relied on the post horse for orders, while a single commander at Yanjing could move tens of thousands of riders across dozens of prefectures on one directive.
people: 決策者是宋太宗趙光義。979年高梁河之敗後，他對幽燕念念不忘，等到遼景宗耶律隆緒病重、蕭太后與韓國王斜軫執政，判定「機不可失」，在雍熙三年正月下詔北伐。東路主帥曹彬是老將，奉命屯雄州，攻幽州月餘不能下，糧道卻先斷；中路田重進自蒲陰出師，接應乏力。西路最關鍵的兩個人是潘美與楊業：潘美掛節度使銜，握西路全軍指揮，卻受監軍王侁牽制，遇事遲疑不決；楊業本名繼業，麟州新秦人，是久經沙場的西北老將，屢次先登陷陣，朔州城下督騎衝鋒時中流矢、股部受傷，行軍至陳家谷口遭遼軍四面埋伏，孤軍苦戰，與子楊延昭等力戰而死，年六十餘。遼方主持者是蕭太后與耶律斜軫：斜軫以燕京統軍使身份率精騎救援幽州，又在陳家谷口一線設伏，使宋軍西路崩潰。
peopleEn: The decision-maker was Emperor Taizong Zhao Kuangyi. After the defeat at Gaoliang River in 979 he could not stop thinking about You and Yan, and when the Liao emperor Yelü Longxu fell ill and Empress Dowager Xiao and Yelü Xiezhen took over the government, he judged that the moment must not be missed and ordered the northern expedition in the first month of the Yongxi third year. The eastern commander was the veteran Cao Bin, posted at Xiongzhou, who failed to take Youzhou after more than a month of siege and ran out of supplies first; the central column under Tian Chongjin, moving out of Puyin, gave little help. The two decisive figures on the western route were Pan Mei and Yang Ye. Pan Mei held the rank of military commissioner and the overall command of the western column, yet he was held back by the supervisor Wang Song and hesitated over every decision. Yang Ye, whose given name was Jiye, was a native of Xinqin in Linyou and an experienced northwestern veteran who had led assaults in person many times; at the foot of Shuozhou he drove the cavalry forward and was struck through the thigh by an arrow, and when the column fell back to Chenjiagu Pass the Liao had already blocked the road on all sides, so the isolated Song force broke up and Yang Ye, fighting alongside his son Yang Yanchao and others, died in the battle, aged over sixty. On the Liao side the moving hands were Empress Dowager Xiao and Yelü Xiezhen, who as commander at Yanjing led elite cavalry to the relief of Youzhou and then set the ambush along the Chenjiagu line that brought down the Song western column.
kits: 卡面的羅馬重步兵並沒有出現在這條戰線上。真正上陣的是宋軍的內襯步卒：他們披札甲、綴鎧裙、戴笠盔，手持長槊與朴刀，配弓、臂弩與手弩，肩上扛著大盾牌，結「步人甲」方陣以長槊拒馬；攻幽州時則用撞車、雲梯、飛石砲與火箭（火矢），配合步卒以盾結陣接近城牆。遼軍是另一套：契丹騎兵輕裝急射，著札甲或皮甲，佩弓刀與長刀，靠馬背上的刀槊與短兵相接，並攜氈帳、箭囊與足糧馬行軍。兩軍的攻城與野戰裝備都受生產能力限制：宋方步軍的重裝不及羅馬的分段鎧甲與重盾，但弩、砲、火矢更早普及；遼方則幾乎全靠騎兵機動與冷箭。羅馬重步兵真正的教訓不在重甲，而在「靠補充兵源與補給線」——宋軍西路在代州、朔州之間拉得太長，糧車不繼，與羅馬帝國在多瑙河上游遇到的困境同類，只是宋人沒有橋頭堡壘可以固守。
kitsEn: The Roman legionary on the card never set foot on this front. What actually fought here were the Song foot soldiers in jacketed armour: they wore plate over padded backing with armoured skirts and pointed helmets, carried long spears and pole sabres, and were armed with bows, forearm crossbows and hand crossbows, while a large shield was shouldered, and the square formation of armoured footmen met the Liao horse with levelled spears. Against Youzhou they brought battering rams, scaling ladders, stone throwers and fire arrows, advancing to the wall behind a shield wall. The Liao fought by a different system: Khitan horsemen shot light and wore plate or leather armour, carrying bows, sabres and long blades, relying on the sword and lance at close quarters, and marching with felt tents, quivers and horses that carried their own fodder. Both sides were bounded by what their workshops could produce. The Song foot soldier was no heavier than a Roman man in segmented plate with a large shield, but crossbows, stone throwers and incendiary arrows were already widespread; the Liao depended almost entirely on mounted mobility and cold arrows. The real lesson of the legionary lies not in the weight of the armour but in the fact that Roman strength rested on manning the ranks and keeping the supply line open. The Song western column strung out too far between Daizhou and Shuozhou and the grain wagons stopped coming, which is the same trap that caught Rome on the upper Danube, except that the Song had no bridgehead forts to hold.
tactics: 三路齊進的戰略意圖是分進合擊：宋太宗想以曹彬的主力牽制幽州方向，再由潘美、田重進分別切斷燕雲西北的支撐，令遼軍首尾不能相顧。遼廷的反應卻更實際：先以遊騎與小股騎兵遲滯宋軍，不與主力糾纏；待宋軍糧秣耗盡、行軍縱隊拉長，再以騎兵切斷糧道、夜襲營壘。西路戰況正如此：潘美與楊業自代州出師後節節推進，奪取沿邊寨柵，楊業以數千騎抵近朔州城下，屢次督戰衝鋒，股中流矢仍不退；軍隊回撤至陳家谷口時，遼軍已四面埋伏，宋軍遂全線崩潰。西路出代州後關內關外的道路狹窄，糧車難以並行，縱隊拉成數十里長的一條線；遼軍不與正面纏鬥，只以小股騎兵不斷襲擾糧隊與輜重，迫使宋軍分兵護衛，主力因此更加疲弱。攻城方與守城方的分野同樣清楚：宋軍屢攻幽州不下，遼軍則以城垣、塞垣、拒馬與遊騎構成縱深防禦，把宋軍拖進「糧盡則退、退則被追」的循環。
tacticsEn: The intent of the three columns moving together was to advance in parallel and converge: Taizong meant to pin the Liao at Youzhou with the main body under Cao Bin while Pan Mei and Tian Chongjin cut the support running north-west through Yuanyun, so that the Liao could not help one front with the other. The Liao court answered in more practical terms. Light horse and small detachments hung back and refused to be drawn into a general action; once the Song grain ran out and the marching columns stretched out, cavalry cut the supply road and struck the camps at night. The western route went exactly this way. After leaving Daizhou, Pan Mei and Yang Ye pushed on and seized the frontier stockades one after another; Yang Ye rode up with several thousand men to the foot of Shuozhou, drove repeated charges and would not withdraw even after an arrow struck his thigh. When the column fell back to Chenjiagu Pass the Liao had already sealed the road on all sides, and the Song line collapsed. Past Daizhou the roads inside and outside the passes were narrow and the grain wagons could hardly pass in file, so the marching order stretched into a line tens of li long; the Liao refused a general engagement, riding in with small parties to harry the baggage trains and the supply column, forcing the Song to detach troops to guard them and leaving the main body still weaker. The difference between the side that attacked and the side that defended is just as clear: the Song never took Youzhou, while the Liao built depth out of walls, frontier barriers, caltrops and patrolling horse, dragging the Song into a cycle in which an empty granary forced a retreat and a retreat invited pursuit.
data: 可核對的數字有限，諸說並存，須加保留。時間線最清楚：雍熙三年（986）正月下詔北伐，楊業陣亡於同年春末夏初之前，約在三四月之間。曹彬攻幽州「月餘」抑或「二十餘日」不能下，各書所記不一。楊業陣亡時年六十餘，這一點《宋史》與家傳所載大致相符。地理上，代州城（今山西代縣）至朔州城（今山西朔州）相距數十公里，道路曲折，中間夾著雁門關外的山地與溪谷；代州至幽州（今北京）則在三百公里以上，全程須在敵境之內維持糧道。兵員方面，三路大軍的總數記載相差甚遠，多以「以十萬計」概之，比較可靠的只有「禁軍為主、邊軍為輔」與「騎兵以契丹人為主」這兩點結構性事實。損耗方面，只有宋軍「失利」「大敗」「糧盡退兵」等定性記載，具體斬獲與陣亡數字基本沒有可靠的原始記載。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are scarce, the accounts differ, and reserve is needed. The timeline is the clearest part of it: the expedition was ordered in the first month of the Yongxi third year (986), and Yang Ye fell in the spring of that same year, roughly between the third and fourth months. Whether Cao Bin's siege of Youzhou lasted more than a month or some twenty days is recorded inconsistently. That Yang Ye was over sixty years old when he died is broadly consistent between the History of Song and the family tradition. Geographically, Daizhou, in present-day Dai County, Shanxi, and Shuozhou, in present-day Shuozhou, Shanxi, lie only some tens of kilometres apart, but the road bends and the way runs through the mountain and valley country north of Yumen Pass. Daizhou to Youzhou, that is, to present-day Beijing, is more than three hundred kilometres, and the whole route had to be supplied inside enemy territory. On the number of men, the totals for the three columns vary widely and are usually given as tens of thousands; the only reliable structural facts are that imperial guard units made up the bulk with frontier troops in support, and that Liao cavalry was chiefly Khitan. On losses, the record carries only qualitative statements such as the expedition failed, was routed, and retreated for want of grain; reliable original figures for killed, captured or taken simply do not exist.
cause: 北伐的直接起因是宋太宗二十年的執念。979年宋軍滅北漢後乘勝攻幽州，卻在高梁河遭遼軍夜襲，趙光義本人中箭受傷，主力喪失，此後二十年間宋遼在河北一線反覆拉鋸，宋廷對幽雲十六州始終視為必取。986年，遼景宗耶律隆緒久病，蕭太后與韓國王斜軫執政，遼軍主力集結在燕京與雲中一帶；宋廷判斷遼方內部虛動，正是北伐的窗口。邊境上的零星衝突提供了開戰名目：遼軍屢次南下抄掠河北，宋廷則把北伐的理由說成是拒遼南侵。更深一層是地緣考量：代州是雁門關外宋軍北出的門戶，先取代州、朔州，切斷幽州與雲中的聯繫，才能把戰線推到燕雲腹地。宋太宗急於在遼主病重、諸將猶疑未定時打成一次決定性的戰役，而不是慢慢磨。北伐前一年，宋廷已在河北、山東各邊州大儲糧草，漕運與民車被大量徵發，正是要讓三路大軍各自離開本籍地作長途作戰；而宋太宗把「取幽雲」與「雪高梁河之恥」視為同一件事，所以拒絕分批出兵，堅持三路同時壓上。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the expedition was an obsession twenty years old. After destroying Northern Han in 979 the Song struck at Youzhou in the same breath and were ambushed by the Liao at night at Gaoliang River, where Zhao Kuangyi himself was wounded by an arrow and the main body was lost; for the next twenty years Song and Liao fought back and forth along the Hebei frontier, and the Song court never ceased to treat the sixteen prefectures of You and Yun as a prize that had to be taken. In 986 the Liao emperor Yelü Longxu was chronically ill, Empress Dowager Xiao and Prince Yelü Xiezhen were in power, and the bulk of the Liao army was concentrated around Yanjing and Yunzhong; the Song court judged that the Liao state was weakened and that this was the opening. Small clashes on the border supplied the pretext: Liao troops repeatedly raided south into Hebei, and the Song framed the expedition as a refusal of Liao aggression. Deeper down lay the strategic reasoning. Daizhou was the gateway through which Song armies left the empire north of Yumen Pass; only by taking Daizhou and Shuozhou first and cutting the link between Youzhou and Yunzhong could the war be pushed into the heart of Yuanyun. Taizong wanted a single decisive battle fought while the Liao emperor lay sick and his commanders had not yet made up their minds, rather than a slow grind. In the year before the expedition the Song court had already banked up large stores of grain in the frontier prefectures of Hebei and Shandong, and the canal transport and private carts of the provinces were heavily requisitioned, precisely so that the three columns could each leave their home districts for a long operation; Taizong treated taking You and Yun and avenging the disaster at Gaoliang River as one and the same business, and so refused to feed the army in instalments, insisting that all three columns press forward at once.
impact: 此役的結果立刻改變了北宋的國策。雍熙北伐三路全敗，宋軍精兵大量損失，河北邊州再無能力主動出擊，北宋自此轉入長期守勢；遼軍則在燕雲十六州屏障後取得主動，隨後數年不斷南下攻宋。楊業的陣亡成了此役最長久的餘波：後世話本、戲曲把陳家谷口的史實重組成「金沙灘」「兩狼關」「潘仁美害忠良」一類的忠奸故事，楊家將的說書與皮戲由此成形，而史實中的責任歸屬、友軍的遲援與失利經過，與演義幾乎相反。物質上，北伐消耗了河北與山東各州倉的存糧，許多邊寨在往後十年都需要重建；軍事技術上，這次遠征暴露了宋軍長距離縱深進攻的後勤極限與攻城器械不足，火器與弩在守城中的作用被重新評估。對後世軍事學的啟示同樣長久：以遠征掠地為目的的攻勢，若沒有就地屯田與穩固的糧道，規模越大崩潰越快，這一條在宋遼、宋金歷次北伐中被反覆驗證，代州之戰遂成為後世論述中最常被引用的失敗範例之一。
impactEn: The outcome changed Song policy at once. All three columns of the Yongxi expedition failed, the Song lost a large part of its trained troops, the frontier prefectures of Hebei could no longer take the offensive, and the Northern Song settled into a long defensive posture; behind the barrier of the sixteen prefectures the Liao held the initiative and raided south year after year. Yang Ye's death had the longest afterlife of anything in the campaign. Later storytellers and stage plays reshaped the record of Chenjiagu Pass into tales of Jin Sha Tan, the Two Wolf Pass and the treacherous Pan Mei destroying a loyal general, and the legends of the Yang family took shape in popular storytelling and opera, while the actual allocation of responsibility, the tardy relief by friendly troops and the course of the rout in the written record are close to the opposite of the staged version. Materially the expedition drew down the stored grain in the provincial granaries of Hebei and Shandong, and many frontier forts had to be rebuilt over the following decade. Militarily it exposed the limits of Song logistics for deep attacks and the thinness of its siege train, and the part played by incendiary weapons and crossbows in defence was reassessed in the light of the campaign. The lesson for later military thought was equally durable: an offensive fought for the sake of overrunning distant ground collapses faster the larger it is, if it lacks garrisons on the spot and a secure supply line, a rule that was tested again and again in the northern campaigns of Song against Liao and against Jin, and the battle of Daizhou became one of the most frequently cited examples of failure in later writing on war.
result: 三路北伐無一成功。曹彬主力攻幽州月餘不下，糧道告急退兵，撤退途中遭遼騎追擊，損失慘重；中路田重進一線同樣受挫；西路最慘，潘美、楊業在朔州城下受創，楊業退至陳家谷口遇伏，力戰陣亡，西路全軍潰散。宋軍退回代州、雁門關內，遼軍重新控制代州、朔州與幽州之間的全部地帶，北伐的戰略目標全部落空。西路的敗訊傳回京師，朝議為之震動，敗兵與失散將士沿代州、忻州一線陸續南撤，沿途收攏散卒、重整隊伍，邊州一時兵力空虛。事後追究戰敗之責，諸史多歸咎於監軍王侁的失職，以及楊業請增援不得、援軍久不至，終致孤軍陷於四面埋伏之中。代州此後仍是宋軍的邊防要地，州城、關隘與寨柵年年修築，抵禦來犯的遼騎；宋太宗自此不再輕言北伐，直至宋真宗景德年間，才在澶州城下以另一種方式與遼廷達成和約。史家評此役，多以「三路並進而糧不濟、孤軍深入而援不至」概括。
resultEn: None of the three columns of the northern expedition succeeded. The main body under Cao Bin failed to take Youzhou after more than a month, broke off when supplies ran low and was harried by Liao horse on the retreat with heavy losses; the central column under Tian Chongjin was checked in turn; the western route ended worst of all, with Pan Mei and Yang Ye hurt in the fighting below Shuozhou and Yang Ye killed in the ambush at Chenjiagu Pass as the column disintegrated. The Song fell back inside Daizhou and behind Yumen Pass, the Liao recovered the whole belt between Daizhou, Shuozhou and Youzhou, and every strategic object of the expedition was lost. The news of the western defeat reached the capital and shook the court; the routed soldiers and stragglers withdrew south along the Daizhou and Xinzhou roads, gathering the scattered men and reforming their units on the way, and the frontier prefectures stood momentarily stripped of troops. When the blame for the defeat was weighed afterwards, the historians laid much of it on the negligence of the supervisor Wang Song and on the fact that Yang Ye's request for reinforcement was never granted and the relief army never came, leaving his isolated force surrounded on all sides. Daizhou remained a frontier stronghold of the Song afterwards, its walls, passes and stockades repaired year by year against Liao raiders, and Taizong no longer spoke lightly of a northern campaign from that point on; it was only under his successor, in the Jingde era, that the Song and the Liao court reached an agreement of a very different kind at Chanzhou. Historians usually compress the campaign into eight characters: three columns advanced together and the grain did not follow; one force went deep alone and no help came.
